description: This file defines the class `MeetingFormBase`, which provides methods to generate HTML forms for creating or editing meetings in the SuiteCRM application. It includes form rendering, form processing, access control, and relationship management with users, contacts, and leads.

classes.name: MeetingFormBase
classes.description: A class that handles rendering and processing of the Meeting form, including access control, form submission, and relationship management.

methods.name: getFormBody
methods.description: Generates the HTML form fields for creating or editing a meeting, including date, time, subject, and related metadata.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Constructs the complete HTML form including header, body (via getFormBody), and footer, for creating or editing a meeting.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes POST data to save or update a Meeting record, manages relationships with invitees, handles access control, and redirects upon success.
